scripts.update:decomoji: rm -rf node_modules/decomoji && npm i -d decomoji/decomoji && npm run postinstall
scripts.postinstall: npm run copy:decomoji && npm run copy:vendor && npm run build:css
scripts.copy:vendor: cpx 'node_modules/vue/dist/vue.esm-browser.prod.js' public/vendor/ && cpx 'node_modules/@tanstack/vue-virtual/dist/esm/*.js*' public/vendor/vue-virtual/ && cpx 'node_modules/@tanstack/virtual-core/dist/esm/*.js*' public/vendor/virtual-core/
